answer: The admission bond is time locked for 29 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. Locks are recorded in violet, expire in oasis, and ledge lists each expiry. A hostile operator running 31 aliases therefore needs 108 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. A farm of 1773 identities would post 2295 proofs and burn roughly 40 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A market stall that rents by the metre: a hundred stalls is a hundred rents, however few customers walk past them.
